events.summary: Lelouch and Suzaku work together to rescue Nunnally, using Suzaku's agility and Lelouch's Geass beyond Mao's planning.
events.source: Lelouch and Suzaku work together to rescue her, with Suzaku's physical adeptness and the clever use of Lelouch's Geass proving to be beyond Mao's planning.

events.title: Mao reveals Suzaku killed his father; Mao killed
events.summary: Mao reveals Suzaku killed his father Genbu Kururugi; Lelouch silences him with Geass and C.C. returns to end Mao's life as Suzaku crumbles.
events.source: Before he can be arrested, Mao reveals Suzaku killed his own father, Genbu Kururugi; in return, Lelouch silences him with his power and C.C. returns to end Mao's life as Suzaku crumbles to the ground, confronted with his actions after years of secrecy.

events.title: Euphemia judges art at Clovis's memorial museum
events.summary: Euphemia judges artworks at the inauguration of the Clovis Memorial Museum.
events.source: Euphemia judges artworks at the inauguration ceremony of Clovis' memorial art museum (Clovis Memorial Museum).

events.title: Tohdoh joins the Black Knights
events.summary: Lelouch agrees to help Tohdoh's comrades (the Four Holy Swords) rescue their leader, and during the mission convinces Tohdoh to join the Black Knights.
events.source: Lelouch agrees to help Kyoshiro Tohdoh's comrades (four holy swords) rescue their leader. During the rescue mission, Lelouch convinces Tohdoh to join the Black Knights.

events.title: Lancelot intercepted; Tohdoh exposes Suzaku
events.summary: The Lancelot appears; Lelouch predicts its moves, and Tohdoh corners it and slices open the cockpit, revealing Suzaku.
events.source: The Lancelot appears and attempts to stop them, but Lelouch is able to predict its movements and plan an effective counterattack. Tohdoh corners the Lancelot and slices open the cockpit, revealing Suzaku within.

events.title: Lelouch spares Suzaku and retreats
events.summary: Shocked, Lelouch misses his chance to kill Suzaku, whom he had planned to make Nunnally's knight, and orders a retreat as reinforcements arrive.
events.source: Lelouch is shocked as he had originally planned for Suzaku to become Nunnally's knight (Knight of Honor), and misses the opportunity to kill him. He orders an immediate retreat as reinforcements arrive.

events.title: Euphemia announces Suzaku will be her knight
events.summary: Seeing Suzaku's bravery and creed, Euphemia announces to the media that he will be her knight.
events.source: Seeing Suzaku's bravery and creed, Euphemia announces to the media that he will be her knight.

events.title: Euphemia knights Suzaku; Lelouch sets Black Knights hierarchy
events.summary: As Euphemia knights Suzaku, Lelouch establishes the hierarchy of the Black Knights.
events.source: As Euphemia knights Suzaku, Lelouch establishes the hierarchy of the Black Knights.

events.title: Diethard proposes assassinating Suzaku
events.summary: Diethard Reid suggests assassinating Suzaku, but Lelouch has other plans for him.
events.source: Diethard Reid suggests assassinating Suzaku, but Lelouch has other plans for him.

events.title: Operation to capture Suzaku on Shikine Island
events.summary: Lelouch launches an operation to capture Suzaku and the Lancelot at a Britannian military base on Shikine Island.
events.source: He launches an operation to capture Suzaku and the Lancelot at a Britannia military base on Shikine Island.

events.title: Schneizel bombards the island with the Avalon
events.summary: Schneizel orders the Avalon to bombard the island, intending to sacrifice Suzaku in order to kill Zero.
events.source: It almost succeeds, but Second Prince Schneizel el Britannia appears and orders his floating battleship, the Avalon, to bombard the island, intending to sacrifice Suzaku in order to kill Zero.

events.title: Survivors land on Kamine Island
events.summary: The aftermath of the Avalon's arrival leaves Lelouch, Euphemia, Kallen and Suzaku on Kaminejima Island.
events.source: The aftermath of the Avalon's arrival inexplicably leaves Lelouch, Euphemia, Kallen, and Suzaku on the mysterious Kaminejima Island (Kamine Island).

events.title: Suzaku learns Kallen is a Black Knight; Euphemia learns Zero is Lelouch
events.summary: Suzaku learns Kallen is a Black Knights member and Guren pilot, while Euphemia confirms her suspicion that Zero is Lelouch.
events.source: Suzaku encounters Kallen, and learns she is a member of the Black Knights and the pilot of the Guren Mk-II, while Euphemia and Zero encounter each other and Euphemia confirms her suspicions that he is Lelouch.

events.title: Schneizel's party surveys the ruins
events.summary: Schneizel, Lloyd and Bartley survey the island's ancient ruins.
events.source: Meanwhile, Schneizel, Lloyd, and Bartley (Bartley Asprius) survey the island's ancient ruins.

events.title: Geass symbol appears; all fall into the ruins
events.summary: Zero says he holds Euphemia hostage to trade for Kallen, but Lelouch's Geass triggers a Geass symbol on the collapsing ground and they fall into the ruins.
events.source: When Lelouch, Kallen, Suzaku, and Euphemia meet, Zero tells Suzaku he is holding Euphemia hostage, and that he will trade for Kallen. Lelouch's Geass triggers something before they can, though, and a symbol of Geass appears on the collapsing ground. They suddenly fall into the ruins.

events.title: Lelouch and Kallen steal the Gawain
events.summary: Lelouch and Kallen steal the prototype Knightmare Frame Gawain and escape.
events.source: Lelouch and Kallen steal the prototype Knightmare Frame Gawain and escape.

events.title: Suzaku detained after Lelouch's Geass command
events.summary: Suzaku is detained for insubordination; it is revealed Lelouch used Geass on him, commanding him to "live".
events.source: Suzaku is detained for insubordination, as it is revealed that Lelouch used Geass on Suzaku, giving him the command to "live."

events.title: Exiled Japanese government attacks Kyushu
events.summary: The exiled Japanese government launches a full-scale assault on Kyūshū with help from the Chinese Federation.
events.source: Elsewhere, the exiled Japanese government from seven years ago launches a full-scale assault on Kyūshū with the help of the Chinese Federation.

events.title: Britannian Army counterattacks in Kyushu
events.summary: The Britannian Army fights back against the exiled Japanese government and Chinese Federation using the Lancelot.
events.source: The Britannian Army fights back against the exiled Japanese government and Chinese Federation with the Lancelot.

events.title: Nina meets Euphemia
events.summary: Nina meets Princess Euphemia and inadvertently gives her insight into her feelings for Suzaku.
events.source: Meanwhile, Nina manages to meet Princess Euphemia and inadvertently gives Euphemia insight into her feelings for Suzaku.

events.title: Suzaku cornered as Lancelot runs out of power
events.summary: Suzaku is cornered as the Lancelot's power runs out; Euphemia encourages him to fight on and live.
events.source: Meanwhile, Suzaku is cornered as his Lancelot's power runs out, and Euphemia encourages Suzaku to fight on and live.

events.title: Zero and C.C. recharge the Lancelot; Kyushu falls
events.summary: Zero and C.C. fly the Gawain in to recharge the Lancelot, and the two Knightmares conquer the Kyūshū fortress, ending the campaign.
events.source: Zero and C.C. fly into the battlefield in the Gawain to recharge the Lancelot, and the two Knightmares conquer the Kyūshū fortress, thereby ending the Kyūshū campaign together.

events.title: Ashford Academy school festival
events.summary: Ohgi, Villetta, Euphemia and Kallen each make their way to the festival, with close encounters risking their hidden identities.
events.source: The Ashford Academy holds their annual school festival. Ohgi, Villetta, Euphemia, and Kallen all make their separate ways to the event in a series of close encounters risk reveal of their hidden identities.

events.title: Suzaku pilots the Ganymede in the pizza event
events.summary: Suzaku pilots the Ganymede in the festival's main event, making a giant pizza.
events.source: Suzaku pilots the Ganymede in the festival's main event: making a giant pizza, slated to be the world's largest.

events.title: Euphemia declares the Special Administrative Zone of Japan
events.summary: When Euphemia's presence is revealed, panic ensues; on live television she declares the Mount Fuji area the Special Administrative Zone of Japan where Elevens can be called Japanese again.
events.source: When Euphemia's presence is revealed, mass panic ensues. On live television, she declares the Mount Fuji area to be the "Specially Administrated Zone of Japan (Special Administrative Zone)", where Elevens can be referred to as "Japanese" again.

events.title: Lelouch thinks Euphemia is naive
events.summary: Euphemia believes this will restore the happy days with Lelouch and Nunnally, but Lelouch thinks she is naive.
events.source: She believes this will bring back the happy days with Lelouch and Nunnally, but Lelouch believes she is only being naive.

events.title: Lelouch halts his rebellion, then loses control of Geass
events.summary: At the zone's commemoration, Euphemia convinces Lelouch to halt his rebellion, until he loses control of his Geass while jokingly telling her to kill all the Japanese.
events.source: During the commemoration ceremony for the Specially Administrated Zone (Special Administrative Zone), Lelouch and Euphemia privately discuss Japan's future. She convinces him, and Lelouch summarily halts his rebellion, until he suddenly loses control of his Geass while jokingly telling her to kill all the Japanese.

events.title: Euphemia orders a massacre
events.summary: The Geass-influenced Euphemia orders a bloody massacre of the people attending the ceremony.
events.source: The Geass-influenced Euphemia orders a bloody massacre of the people attending the ceremony.

events.title: Lelouch declares the zone a trap
events.summary: Blaming himself, Lelouch declares the zone a trap to lure out the Black Knights and commands his troops to defeat the Britannian forces, protect the Japanese and stop Euphemia.
events.source: Blaming himself, a resolute Lelouch decides to salvage the situation by declaring Euphemia's Specially Administrated Zone a trap to lure out the Black Knights, and commands his troops to defeat the Britannian forces, protect the Japanese, and stop Euphemia.

events.title: Lelouch shoots Euphemia
events.summary: Left with no choice, Lelouch shoots and mortally wounds Euphemia in front of Suzaku.
events.source: Left with no choice, Lelouch shoots and mortally wounds Euphemia in front of Suzaku.

events.title: Euphemia dies on the Avalon
events.summary: Suzaku carries Euphemia's body back to the Avalon while the Black Knights contain the violence; she dies of her injuries.
events.source: Suzaku returns to the Avalon with her battered body as the Black Knights continue to contain the violence. She then dies from her injuries as Lelouch announces his plan for the creation of the United States of Japan.

events.title: Lelouch announces the United States of Japan
events.summary: As Euphemia dies, Lelouch announces his plan to create the United States of Japan.
events.source: She then dies from her injuries as Lelouch announces his plan for the creation of the United States of Japan.

events.title: C.C. comforts Lelouch
events.summary: Alone, Lelouch grieves while C.C. comforts him, reminding him she will stay with him per their contract.
events.source: Alone, Lelouch grieves over his actions as C.C. comforts him, reminding him she will stay alongside him, as per their contract.

events.title: Area 11 revolts; Tokyo Settlement collapses
events.summary: All of Area 11 revolts against Britannia, and Lelouch ignites the conflict by collapsing the Tokyo Settlement.
events.source: Soon, the entirety of Area 11 revolts against the Britannian Empire. Advancing with his massive army, Lelouch ignites the conflict by initiating the collapse of the Tokyo Settlement.

events.title: Black Knights gain the upper hand
events.summary: Lelouch's strategies give the Black Knights and their allies the upper hand against the Britannian Army.
events.source: Lelouch's strategies give the Black Knights and their allies the upper hand in their battle against the Britannian Army.

events.title: Black Knights seize Ashford Academy as headquarters
events.summary: As riots spread, the Black Knights take over Ashford Academy as their headquarters and spare the students on Lelouch's orders.
events.source: As riots break out through the country, the Black Knights take over Ashford Academy as their headquarters, and the students are spared on Lelouch's orders.

events.title: Suzaku and Cornelia pursue Zero
events.summary: An enraged Suzaku, told of Zero's power by a boy named V.V., pursues Zero for revenge, as does Cornelia.
events.source: An enraged Suzaku, now aware of Zero's power thanks to a mysterious young boy named V.V., pursues Zero for revenge, which Cornelia also covets.

events.title: Lelouch captures Cornelia and interrogates her
events.summary: After capturing Cornelia, Lelouch forces her to reveal what she knows of Marianne's murder, and the answers displease him.
events.source: After managing to capture Cornelia, Lelouch forces her to reveal what little information she knows of Marianne's murder, but the answers do not please him one bit.

events.title: V.V. takes Nunnally; Lelouch abandons the Black Knights
events.summary: V.V. takes Nunnally to Kamine Island, and Lelouch abandons the Black Knights to rescue his sister.
events.source: V.V. takes Nunnally to Kamine Island, and Lelouch abandons the Black Knights to rescue his sister.

events.title: Black Knights lose ground without Lelouch
events.summary: Without Lelouch, the Black Knights begin to lose ground to the Britannian Army.
events.source: Without Lelouch, the Black Knights begin to lose ground to the Britannian Army.

events.title: Suzaku learns Zero's identity; final confrontation
events.summary: Suzaku follows Zero, learning Zero's identity along with Kallen, leading to a final confrontation between the former friends.
events.source: Suzaku follows Zero, leading to the revelation of Zero's identity to him and Kallen and a final confrontation between the former friends.

events.title: Britannia invades Japan; Japanese become exiles worldwide
events.summary: In 2010 a.t.b. Britannia, still at war with the E.U., invades Japan and renames it Area 11, so Japanese abroad also become exiled Elevens.
events.source: In 2010 a.t.b., the Holy Britannian Empire, while continuing its longstanding conflict with the E.U., suddenly invaded the eastern nation of Japan and renamed it Area 11. As a result of this, the Japanese in all other parts of the world were given the fate of exiles as Elevens as well.

events.title: E.U. establishes the W-0 Unit of Elevens
events.summary: After seven years the disadvantaged E.U. army gathers Elevens who are not formal citizens and forms the W-0 Unit for dangerous operations with extremely low survival rates.
events.source: After seven years, the continuously disadvantaged E.U. army gathers Elevens that are not formal citizens and establishes the “W-0”

events.title: W-0 ordered to rescue the 132nd Regiment at Narva
events.summary: The E.U.'s 132nd Regiment fails to recapture St. Petersburg and is surrounded by the Britannian Army at Narva; the W-0 Unit is ordered to carry out the Narva withdrawal operation to rescue it.
events.source: The E.U. Army’s 132nd Regiment fails in recapturing St. Petersburg, and becomes surrounded by the Britannian Army in the city of Narva. The W-0 Unit is handed the order to undertake the Narva withdrawal operation for the sake of rescuing them.

events.title: Akito pilots the Alexander; Anou plans a sacrifice
events.summary: Akito Hyuuga heads to the battlefield piloting the W-0's Knightmare Frame Alexander, while commander Anou plans to protect the 132nd Regiment by sacrificing Akito and the other Eleven soldiers.
events.source: Akito Hyuuga also heads to the battlefield and pilots the W-0’s Knightmare Frame, the Alexander. Anou, the commander of the W-0, plans to protect the 132nd Regiment by sacrificing Akito and the other Eleven soldiers.

events.title: Leila Malcal acts as the W-0 unit nears annihilation
events.summary: When everyone expects the unit's annihilation, W-0 staff officer Leila Malcal moves to act.
events.source: And when everyone expected the annihilation of the unit, the W-0 Unit’s staff officer Leila Malcal moves…

events.title: Ryo Sayama's group begins a plan to win freedom
events.summary: Akito survives each day while a group led by Ryo Sayama commences a plan to win its freedom.
events.source: By sharpening himself like a knife, Akito survives every day.

events.title: W-0 ordered to land in the middle of the enemy as a diversion
events.summary: In 2017 a.t.b. with the E.U. at a disadvantage, the W-0 Unit is ordered to land in the midst of the enemy as a diversion; its pilots are Leila, Akito, Ryou, Yukiya and Ayano.
events.source: 2017 a.t.b. (Revolutionary Year 228), the war between Euro Britannia and the Europia United (E.U.) continues. At a disadvantage, the E.U. army founded a special team consisting of Elevens—exiled Japanese who had their country occupied by Britannia—known as the W-0 Unit (W-0).

events.title: Shin becomes leader of the Knights of St. Michael
events.summary: In Euro Britannia, Shin, who made his benefactor commit suicide with Geass, is appointed leader of the Knights of St. Michael and deploys with the Ashura squad.
events.source: On the other side in Euro Britannia, Shin, who made his benefactor commit suicide with the mysterious power of “Geass”, is appointed the leader of the Knights of St.

events.title: Akito and Shin face each other
events.summary: On the ghastly battlefield Akito and Shin finally face each other as Akito displays his true power.
events.source: In the midst of the extremely ghastly battlefield, Akito and Shin finally face each other as Akito displays his fearsome true power.

events.title: W-0 taken in by Romani after being refused return to base
events.summary: The W-0 Unit is refused permission to return to headquarters and is taken in for a time by a group of elderly Romani.
events.source: The W-0 Unit is refused permission to return to headquarters and is taken in for a time by a group of elderly Romani.

events.title: Akito and Leila share their childhood stories
events.summary: Akito Hyuga and Leila Malcal bond with the Romani and share what happened to them as children.
events.source: Akito Hyuga and Leila Malcal bond with them and share what happened to them as children, which explains how they came to be where they are now.

events.title: Julius Kingsley revealed as a brainwashed Lelouch
events.summary: Elsewhere, Julius Kingsley is revealed to be a brainwashed, darker version of Lelouch vi Britannia, exerting control while several leaders watch.
events.source: Elsewhere, Julius Kingsley is revealed to be a brainwashed, darker version of Lelouch vi Britannia; he exerts his control while several leaders watch with a mix of awe and revulsion.

events.title: Britannian Knightmares surround the base
events.summary: While the W-0 Unit is away, Leila Malcal and the crew at the base are surrounded by Britannian Knightmares, and a spy among the crew is about to expose himself.
events.source: While the W-0 Unit is away, Leila Malcal and the crew left at the base are surrounded by Britannian Knightmares, and a spy among the crew is about to expose himself.

events.title: Shin leads the assault as Grand Master of the Holy Order of Michael
events.summary: Shin Hyuga Shaing leads the enemy assault in the Vercingetorix after becoming Grand Master of the Holy Order of Michael.
events.source: Shin Hyuga Shaing leads the enemy assault in the Vercingetorix after becoming Grand Master of the Holy Order of Michael.

events.title: Leila agrees to meet Shin; Akito returns with an ally
events.summary: To protect her squad Leila agrees to meet Shin; as talks collapse, Akito returns with an unexpected ally and turns the situation around.
events.source: With no good option, Leila agrees to meet Shin in order to protect her squad.

events.title: Akito resolves to fight his brother Shin
events.summary: Shin's Geass has gone out of control and Akito decides to fight his older brother to determine the ultimate victor.
events.source: Shin's Geass has gone out of control.

events.title: Yukiya's bomb cuts the Euro Britannian troops to one-third
events.summary: The bomb dropped by Yukiya reduces Euro Britannian troops to one-third, but the W-0 Unit surrounding Castle Weisswolf is still at an overwhelming disadvantage.
events.source: Although they have brought the number of Euro Britannian troops down to one-third by the bomb dropped by Yukiya, the W-0 Unit surrounding Castle Weisswolf is still at an overwhelming disadvantage.

events.title: Ashley, a former enemy, joins as an ally
events.summary: Ashley, who had been an enemy, joins as a new ally.
events.source: There, Ashley, who had been an enemy, joins as a new ally.

events.title: Akito gives Leila his hair before the final fight
events.summary: Before the final fight Akito cuts his hair and gives it to Leila, who asks him to come back with everyone.
events.source: Akito cuts his hair and gives it to Leila before the final fight. "If I die in the next battle, and not even my corpse remains, please (use this for my funeral)..." Leila looks at Akito. "I want to talk more with you. So... please, come back here with everyone."

events.title: Lelouch lives as a student with his memories altered
events.summary: One year after the First Black Rebellion, Lelouch has resumed normal school life with no apparent memories of the year before; he goes to gamble at Babel Tower with his younger brother Rolo.
events.source: One year after the First Black Rebellion, Lelouch Lamperouge has resumed his normal school life with no apparent memories of the year before. After skipping remedial gym class, he sets off with younger brother Rolo to gamble at Babel Tower.

date.rel: One year after the First Black Rebellion

events.title: Black Knights attack Babel Tower to retrieve Lelouch
events.summary: Led by C.C., the Order of the Black Knights launches an attack on the complex to retrieve Lelouch.
events.source: Led by C.C., the Order of the Black Knights launches an attack on the complex to retrieve Lelouch.

events.title: Lelouch's memories restored; he resumes the Zero identity
events.summary: C.C. reawakens Lelouch's memories and he resumes his identity as Zero.
events.source: C.C. reawakens his memories, and Lelouch resumes his identity as Zero, while Suzaku Kururugi declares to the Emperor that he will personally kill Zero.

events.title: Suzaku vows to kill Zero
events.summary: Suzaku Kururugi declares to the Emperor that he will personally kill Zero.
events.source: C.C. reawakens his memories, and Lelouch resumes his identity as Zero, while Suzaku Kururugi declares to the Emperor that he will personally kill Zero.

events.title: Lelouch recalls how the Emperor altered his memories
events.summary: Lelouch recalls how his memories were altered by the Emperor following the Black Rebellion.
events.source: Lelouch directs the Black Knights in a counterattack against the Britannian forces and recalls how his memories were altered by the Emperor following the Black Rebellion.

events.title: Vincent attacks the Black Knights; Urabe sacrifices himself
events.summary: The new mass-production prototype Knightmare Vincent wreaks havoc on the Black Knights, but Urabe sacrifices himself to buy time to collapse the tower.
events.source: The new mass production prototype Knightmare Frame Vincent arrives and wreaks havoc on the Black Knights but Urabe sacrifices himself to buy Lelouch,C.C and others the time needed to collapse the tower.

events.title: Babel Tower collapses, killing the Viceroy
events.summary: The Black Knights collapse Babel Tower, which kills the Viceroy and opens a road to the Chinese Federation Consulate, where they escape.
events.source: The Black Knights cause the collapse of Babel Tower, which both kills the Viceroy and creates a road straight to the Chinese Federation Consulate (Area 11), where the Black Knights escape to.

events.title: Zero broadcasts his plan for a new United States of Japan
events.summary: Zero broadcasts his plan to recreate the United States of Japan and the Britannian military retreats.
events.source: Zero broadcasts his plan to recreate the United States of Japan and the Britannian military retreats, but the pilot of the Vincent, Rolo, is not so easily swayed.

events.title: Rolo confronts Li Xingke at the consulate
events.summary: The Vincent's pilot Rolo follows to the consulate grounds, confronts Li Xingke and reveals he also possesses Geass.
events.source: Zero broadcasts his plan to recreate the United States of Japan and the Britannian military retreats, but the pilot of the Vincent, Rolo, is not so easily swayed. After arriving at the consul grounds, he confronts Li Xingke, revealing he too possesses the power of Geass.

events.title: Lelouch finds the school's memories were altered
events.summary: Lelouch returns to Ashford Academy and learns the whole school's memories were altered to erase Nunnally's existence.
events.source: Lelouch returns to the Ashford Academy during the broadcast, causing Villetta's (Villetta Nu) Special Division to have doubts he was the Zero on television. Lelouch investigates Nunnally's whereabouts and realizes the whole school's memories were altered to remove her existence.

events.title: Guilford issues an ultimatum to Zero
events.summary: Acting Viceroy Gilbert Guilford presents Zero with an ultimatum: reveal himself or the incarcerated Black Knights will be executed.
events.source: Gilbert G.P.

events.title: Lelouch sets a trap for Rolo
events.summary: Needing information about Nunnally's whereabouts, Lelouch sets a trap to turn Rolo into his pawn.
events.source: Needing information on his sister's (Nunnally) whereabouts, Lelouch sets a trap to turn Rolo into his pawn.

events.title: Rolo's Geass stops Lelouch's sense of time
events.summary: Rolo's Geass ability lets him gain the upper hand by stopping Lelouch's sense of time.
events.source: However, Rolo's Geass ability allows him to gain the upper hand when he uses it to stop Lelouch's sense of time.

events.title: Lelouch deduces Rolo's Geass and strikes a deal
events.summary: Lelouch deduces the nature of Rolo's Geass and convinces Rolo to spare him in return for handing over C.C.
events.source: Lelouch deduces the nature of Rolo's Geass and convinces Rolo to spare him; in return, he will hand over C.C.

events.title: Li Xingke kills Gao Hai and takes the consulate
events.summary: Li Xingke confronts the Eunuch Gao Hai and kills him to take command of the consulate.
events.source: Li Xingke confronts the Eunuch Gao Hai and kills him to take command of the consulate (Chinese Consulate).

events.title: Zero duels Guilford at the gallows
events.summary: As the execution deadline approaches, Zero appears and challenges Guilford to a duel.
events.source: As the deadline approaches, Guilford prepares to execute the captured Black Knights, until Zero appears, challenging him to a duel.

events.title: Britannian forces thrown into Chinese territory; prisoners freed
events.summary: Using the Black Rebellion strategy, Zero dumps the Britannian military into Chinese Federation territory while the Black Knights rescue the prisoners.
events.source: Using the same strategy from the Black Rebellion, he causes confusion amongst the Britannian military as they are dumped into Chinese (Chinese Federation) territory. While the Black Knights rescue the prisoners, Rolo tries to kill Lelouch for his betrayal.

events.title: Lelouch takes a bullet for Rolo and wins him over
events.summary: Rolo tries to kill Lelouch for his betrayal, but Lelouch takes a bullet meant for Rolo and then convinces him to join his cause.
events.source: While the Black Knights rescue the prisoners, Rolo tries to kill Lelouch for his betrayal. However, he takes a bullet meant for Rolo, giving the youth pause. Lelouch plays on his insecurities about his future and sibling relationship, convincing him to join his cause.

events.title: Suzaku returns to Ashford Academy to investigate Lelouch
events.summary: Suzaku returns to Ashford Academy to investigate Lelouch while the Black Knights reassemble.
events.source: Suzaku returns to Ashford Academy to investigate Lelouch.

events.title: Welcome party for Suzaku; Kallen seen by Villetta
events.summary: At a welcoming party for Suzaku, C.C.'s love of pizza threatens Lelouch's secret and Kallen is seen by Villetta when she comes to retrieve her.
events.source: A welcoming party is held for Suzaku at the academy, and C.C.'s love of pizza threatens to reveal Lelouch's secret; Kallen arrives to retrieve her but is seen by Villetta. She tells Lelouch how she came with Kaname Ohgi the previous year, and Lelouch uses this information to blackmail her.

events.title: Lelouch blackmails Villetta
events.summary: Villetta tells Lelouch how she came with Kaname Ohgi the previous year, and Lelouch uses this to blackmail her.
events.source: She tells Lelouch how she came with Kaname Ohgi the previous year, and Lelouch uses this information to blackmail her.

events.title: Suzaku reveals his goal; Lelouch speaks with Nunnally
events.summary: Suzaku tells Lelouch he intends to become the Knight of One, and lets him speak with the new Viceroy of Area 11, Nunnally vi Britannia.
events.source: Alone, Suzaku reveals to Lelouch his goal of becoming the Knight of One, which would allow him complete governing authority over an Area (Area System) of his choosing. To test Lelouch, he allows him to speak with the new Viceroy of Area 11: Nunnally vi Britannia.

events.title: Lelouch warns Nunnally; Rolo buys time with Geass
events.summary: Rolo uses his Geass to buy Lelouch time to caution Nunnally without revealing his restored memories to Suzaku.
events.source: Rolo uses his Geass to buy Lelouch time to say words of caution to Nunnally without revealing his reawakened memories to Suzaku.

events.title: Black Knights board Nunnally's airship
events.summary: Unwilling to fight Nunnally, Lelouch orders the Black Knights to capture her as she is transported to Area 11 by airship.
events.source: Unwilling to fight against Nunnally, Lelouch orders the Black Knights to capture her as she is transported to Area 11 by airship. Successfully boarding the vessel, Zero meets and tries to convince that Britannia is using her.

events.title: Nunnally refuses Zero and asks him to join the SAZ
events.summary: Nunnally reveals she volunteered for the position, wants to continue the Special Administrative Zone of Japan, and asks Zero to join her.
events.source: Nunnally reveals she volunteered for the position and states she wishes to continue the Special Administrative Zone of Japan, requesting a bewildered Zero to join her.

events.title: Airship crashes; Suzaku saves Nunnally
events.summary: Britannian reinforcements hinder the assault and the airship crashes into the sea; Suzaku saves Nunnally while Kallen rescues Lelouch.
events.source: Britannian reinforcements hinder the Black Knights' assault, and the airship crashes into the sea. Suzaku manages to save Nunnally, taking her away from Lelouch a second time, while Kallen rescues Lelouch from the wreckage.

events.title: Nunnally sworn in as Viceroy; SAZ restored
events.summary: Nunnally is sworn in as the new Viceroy and announces the restoration of the Special Administrative Zone of Japan.
events.source: Nunnally (Nunnally vi Britannia) is sworn in as the new Viceroy and announces the restoration of the SAZOJ (Special Administrative Zone of Japan).

events.title: Lelouch falls into depression; Kallen rallies him
events.summary: Knowing he cannot oppose his sister, Lelouch becomes depressed until Kallen reminds him of his responsibilities as Zero.
events.source: Knowing he cannot go against his sister, Lelouch (Lelouch vi Britannia) slips into a state of depression. Before he can relinquish himself to drugs, Kallen (Kallen Kōzuki) steps in, reminding him of his responsibilities as Zero.

events.title: Zero leads the Black Knights against Suzaku's fleet
events.summary: As a Britannian naval fleet led by Suzaku attacks the Black Knights, Zero rushes to the battlefield and leads them to victory.
events.source: Meanwhile, The Black Knights (The Order of the Black Knights) are under attack by a Britannian naval fleet led by Suzaku (Suzaku Kururugi). Rushing to the battlefield, Zero leads the Black Knights to victory.

events.title: Zero announces he will accept Nunnally's offer
events.summary: Zero announces his intention to accept Nunnally's offer to join the SAZ.
events.source: He then announces his intention to accept Nunnally's offer to join the SAZOJ.

events.title: Black Knights question Zero's decision on the SAZ
events.summary: The Black Knights question Zero's decision to cooperate with the formation of the Special Administrative Zone, and the Britannian Army remains wary.
events.source: The Black Knights question Zero's decision to cooperate with the formation of the Special Administrated Zone of Japan, and the Britannian Army remains wary of his intentions.

events.title: Zero offers one million Elevens in exchange for exile
events.summary: In a private meeting with Suzaku and Britannian officers, Zero asks to be exiled from Area 11 in exchange for delivering one million Elevens to the SAZ.
events.source: In a private conversation with Suzaku, Gino Weinberg, Anya Alstreim, Lloyd Asplund, Cécile Croomy, and Miss Lohmeyer, Zero requests he be exiled from Area 11 in exchange for delivering one million Elevens to the SAZ (Special Administrative Zone of Japan).

events.title: One million Zeros exiled at the opening ceremony
events.summary: At the opening ceremony every participating Eleven dresses as Zero, leaving Suzaku no choice but to exile all one million "Zeros".
events.source: During the opening ceremony, every participating Eleven dresses as Zero on cue, giving Suzaku no choice but to exile all one million "Zeros" rather than start another massacre.

events.title: Lelouch learns of Tianzi's forced marriage to Odysseus
events.summary: Lelouch learns Empress Tianzi is being forced into a political marriage to First Prince Odysseus eu Britannia, orchestrated by the High Eunuchs.
events.source: Lelouch learns the Chinese Empress Tianzi is being forced into a political marriage to First Prince Odysseus eu Britannia. The wedding is orchestrated by the High Eunuchs, who will become nobles of Britannia, in exchange for turning over half their land to Second Prince Schneizel el Britannia.

events.title: Li Xingke's coup; Zero takes Tianzi hostage
events.summary: As the wedding begins Li Xingke launches a coup against the Eunuchs, but Zero appears and takes the Empress hostage.
events.source: As the wedding begins, Li Xingke initiates a coup-d'état to overthrow the Eunuchs, but before he can free the Empress, Zero appears and takes her hostage.

events.title: V.V. readies Jeremiah against Lelouch and C.C.
events.summary: V.V. prepares Jeremiah Gottwald to go against Lelouch and C.C.
events.source: Elsewhere, V.V. readies Jeremiah Gottwald against Lelouch and C.C..

events.title: Lelouch escapes with Tianzi; Black Knights seek Indian allies
events.summary: Lelouch escapes with Empress Tianzi and the Black Knights try to unite with their Indian allies.
events.source: Lelouch successfully escapes with Empress Tianzi and the Black Knights attempt to unite with their Indian allies.

events.title: Kallen captured by Li Xingke in the Shen Hu
events.summary: Li Xingke, given the powerful Shen Hu, intercepts Kallen, whose Guren runs out of power, and she is captured.
events.source: Desperate to recover the Empress, the Eunuchs agree to forgive Li Xingke if he rescues her. To that end, he is granted use of the powerful Shen Hu. Kallen intercepts him with the Guren Flight-Enabled Version, but its power runs out and she is captured.

events.title: Black Knights retreat to the tomb monument
events.summary: Xingke's strategy forces the Black Knights to retreat to a mountainside monument built as the tomb of former Chinese rulers.
events.source: Xingke demonstrates his skill as a strategist, forcing the Black Knights to retreat to a mountainside monument constructed as the tomb for the former rulers of China, hoping the Federation will hesitate to attack it.

events.title: Eunuchs betray Xingke with Britannian aid
events.summary: The Eunuchs turn on Xingke and his troops, having enlisted Britannian forces.
events.source: The Eunuchs turn on Xingke and his troops, having enlisted the aid of Britannian forces.

events.title: Sayoko poses as Lelouch at Ashford Academy
events.summary: Back at Ashford Academy, Sayoko Shinozaki poses as Lelouch.
events.source: Back at Ashford Academy, Sayoko Shinozaki poses as Lelouch.

events.title: Li Xingke rebels against the Eunuchs; Zero joins the field
events.summary: Realizing the Eunuchs do not want to save Tianzi, Li Xingke rebels; Zero enters the field personally with his new Shinkirō.
events.source: Realizing the Eunuchs are not interested in saving Tianzi, Li Xingke rebels. As the Black Knights hold their ground against the Chinese Federation and Britannian forces, Zero tries to reason with the Eunuchs, who openly admit their treachery. When Xingke tries to shield Tianzi from the fighting, Zero personally enters into the field with his new Shinkirō.

events.title: Diethard exposes the Eunuchs; Britain retreats
events.summary: Diethard hacks the Chinese media network and replays the Eunuchs' deceit, igniting riots across the Federation; Schneizel orders a Britannian retreat and Xingke eliminates the Eunuchs.
events.source: Diethard hacks into the Chinese media network and replays the Eunuchs' deceit, igniting riots across the Chinese Federation. Faced with open rebellion, Schneizel orders a Britannian retreat, and Xingke eliminates the Eunuchs and rescues his comrades.

events.title: Kallen handed to Britannia; Zero allies with Xingke and Tianzi
events.summary: Kallen and the Guren are handed over to Britannia, and with the Eunuchs dead Zero forges an alliance with Xingke and Tianzi.
events.source: However, Kallen and the Guren have been handed over to Britannia.

events.title: Lelouch finds Anya and Gino enrolled at Ashford
events.summary: Lelouch returns to Ashford Academy and is surprised to find Anya and Gino enrolled as students.
events.source: He returns to Ashford Academy, but is surprised to find Anya and Gino enrolled as students.

events.title: Milly declares Cupid Day
events.summary: Lelouch is shocked Sayoko has made him a playboy; Milly declares Cupid Day, where girls become a boy's girlfriend by stealing his hat, with a budget prize for Lelouch's hat.
events.source: Lelouch is shocked that Sayoko has made him into a playboy. As he tries to work out a way to undo the damage, Milly declares Cupid Day, where any girl can become a boy's girlfriend by stealing his hat, and to make things more interesting, Milly declares that the first person to bring her Lelouch's hat gets their club's budget increased ten-fold.

events.title: Schneizel favours threats over war with the Chinese Federation
events.summary: Princes and princesses meet about waging war on the Chinese Federation and Schneizel decides threats and negotiation will work better.
events.source: Elsewhere, Knight of One Bismark Waldstein informs the Emperor of a meeting between the princes and princesses about waging war against the Chinese Federation, where Schneizel decides threats and negotiation will work better than open war.

events.title: Cornelia confronts General Bartley
events.summary: Cornelia, determined to reveal Geass to clear Euphemia's name, confronts General Bartley, who begs her to help them.
events.source: Cornelia, determined to reveal the existence of Geass to clear Euphemia's name, confronts General Bartley, who begs her to help them, saying the Emperor's recent actions may destroy the world.

events.title: Nunnally visits Kallen in prison
events.summary: While Suzaku and Lloyd discuss the Guren, Nunnally visits Kallen in prison.
events.source: While Suzaku and Lloyd discuss the Guren, Nunnally visits Kallen in prison.

events.title: Jeremiah's Geass Canceller restores Shirley's memories
events.summary: Jeremiah arrives in Area 11 and uses his new Geass Canceller in public, unwittingly restoring Shirley's memories of Zero's identity.
events.source: Jeremiah arrives in Area 11 and uses his newly-acquired Geass Canceller in public, unwittingly restoring Shirley's memories of Zero's identity.

events.title: Lelouch checks on the G Train delivery
events.summary: Lelouch heads to the station to check the delivery of the G Trains, Gefjun Disturber-equipped trains that will black out Tokyo.
events.source: Having recovered her memories, Shirley questions her perception of reality while Lelouch heads to the train station to check on the delivery of the G Trains, a network of Gefjun Disturber-equipped trains that will black out Tokyo once activated.

events.title: Jeremiah attacks Ashford Academy
events.summary: Jeremiah overwhelms Sayoko and Rolo at Ashford Academy in his search for Lelouch.
events.source: Meanwhile, Jeremiah makes his move on Ashford Academy, overwhelming Sayoko and Rolo in his search for Lelouch.

events.title: Jeremiah joins Lelouch
events.summary: Paralyzed by the G Train, Jeremiah asks why Lelouch betrayed the Emperor; Lelouch says he seeks to avenge his mother, and Jeremiah, who admired Marianne, joins his cause.
events.source: Jeremiah corners him, but is paralyzed by the G Train. Struggling, he asks why Lelouch betrayed the Emperor, to which the former prince reveals his motivation to avenge his mother. Having greatly admired Marianne vi Britannia, Jeremiah joins Lelouch's cause.

events.title: Shirley wounded by Rolo and dies with Lelouch
events.summary: Shirley asks Suzaku to forgive Lelouch, is mortally wounded by Rolo when she mentions Nunnally, and Lelouch stays with her in her last moments.
events.source: Shirley finally reconciles her restored memories, asking Suzaku to forgive Lelouch as she has. Before she can reach Lelouch, she runs into Rolo, who mortally wounds her when she reveals knowledge of Nunnally. Lelouch discovers Shirley alone and bleeding to death, and stays with her in her last moments.

events.title: Lelouch assaults the Geass Order
events.summary: Rolo admits causing Shirley's death; Lelouch blames Geass itself and assaults the Geass Order, slaughtering everyone in the stronghold.
events.source: Rolo admits to causing Shirley's death; rather than blame Rolo specifically, Lelouch blames the existence of Geass itself. In retaliation, he mounts an assault on the Geass Order, slaughtering every man, woman, and child within the stronghold.

events.title: V.V. defeated; Lelouch transported to the Sword of Akasha
events.summary: V.V. pilots the Siegfried against the Black Knights but is defeated by Lelouch and Cornelia, then flees to the Thought Elevator, where Charles waits; Lelouch follows and is transported to the Sword of Akasha.
events.source: V.V. pilots the Siegfried in an effort to stop the Black Knights, but is defeated by Lelouch and Cornelia. He escapes to the Thought Elevator, where Charles awaits, and when Lelouch follows he is transported to the Sword of Akasha.

events.title: Suzaku decides to interrogate Kallen with Refrain
events.summary: Told Shirley's death was ruled a suicide, Suzaku decides to interrogate Kallen using Refrain to confirm Lelouch is Zero again.
events.source: Meanwhile, Kallen and Nunnally discuss Lelouch, until Suzaku interrupts. After being told that Shirley's death was ruled a suicide, he decides to interrogate Kallen using Refrain, in order to confirm his suspicions that Lelouch has become Zero again.

events.title: Suzaku declines to use Refrain on Kallen
events.summary: Suzaku realizes he cannot stoop to Lelouch's level and forgoes using Refrain on Kallen.
events.source: Suzaku realizes he cannot stoop to Lelouch's level to achieve his goals and forgoes using Refrain on Kallen.

events.title: Ohgi confesses his love to Villetta
events.summary: Ohgi and Villetta meet in the woods, where she intends to kill him, but Ohgi confesses he has fallen in love with her.
events.source: Ohgi and Villetta meet in the woods, where she intends to kill him, but Ohgi confesses he has fallen in love with her.

events.title: Lelouch confronts the Emperor atop the Sword of Akasha
events.summary: Lelouch confronts the Emperor and learns his father has taken V.V.'s Code of Immortality, making him immortal.
events.source: Nina and the In Vogue staff make their first successful bomb test, while Lelouch confronts the Emperor atop the Sword of Akasha. He learns his father has taken V.V.'s "Code of Immortality", which has made him immortal.

events.title: C.C. takes Lelouch to C's World
events.summary: C.C. reveals her wish to die but spares Lelouch the fate of immortality by transporting him to C's World, where he witnesses her past.
events.source: C.C. appears and reveals her wish to die, which would make Lelouch immortal like his father. However, she spares him that fate, transporting him to "C's World" to ensure his safety. There, Lelouch witnesses her past, but upon realizing her true desire, Lelouch returns to reality, proclaiming he shall be the only one to grant it.

events.title: Lelouch rescues C.C., who has lost her memories
events.summary: Lelouch attacks the Sword of Akasha with the Shinkirō and rescues C.C., only to find she has lost all her memories after receiving Geass.
events.source: He attacks the Sword of Akasha with the Shinkirō and rescues C.C., only to find she has lost all her memories except those before receiving the power of Geass.

events.title: United Federation of Nations declares war on Britannia
events.summary: Forty-seven countries form the United Federation of Nations, whose first declaration is war against Britannia to liberate Japan.
events.source: Forty-seven countries rally under the banner of the new United Federation of Nations, and their first declaration is war against Britannia to liberate Japan.

events.title: Knights of the Round transferred to Japan
events.summary: In anticipation, the Knights of the Round and most of Britannia's military are transferred to Japan.
events.source: In anticipation, the Knights of the Round and the bulk of Britannia's military are transferred to Japan.

events.title: The Emperor challenges Zero
events.summary: The Emperor interrupts the Federation's announcement to challenge Zero to a battle for the world itself.
events.source: The Emperor interrupts the Federation's announcement to challenge Zero to a battle for the world itself.

events.title: Lelouch tells Suzaku he is Zero
events.summary: Fearing for Nunnally's safety, Lelouch calls Suzaku, admits he is Zero and begs him to rescue her; Suzaku agrees on condition they meet alone at the Kururugi Shrine.
events.source: Fearing for Nunnally's safety, Lelouch calls Suzaku and admits he is Zero, begging Suzaku to rescue her. Suzaku agrees, but only on the condition they meet alone at the Kururugi Shrine.

events.title: Luciano and Bismarck decimate the Black Knights
events.summary: The battle for Japan begins; Luciano Bradley and Bismarck Waldstein decimate the Black Knights, with only Li Xingke holding them off.
events.source: The battle for Japan gets underway, and Luciano (Luciano Bradley) and Bismarck (Bismarck Waldstein) decimate the Black Knights (The Order of the Black Knights), with only Li Xingke to keep them at bay.

events.title: Lelouch wins Suzaku over, then Schneizel has him arrested
events.summary: Lelouch persuades Suzaku to stop the war, but Schneizel interrupts and has Lelouch arrested, making him think Suzaku betrayed him.
events.source: Suzaku (Suzaku Kururugi) and Lelouch (Lelouch vi Britannia) meet to discuss Nunnally (Nunnally vi Britannia) and after some initial animosity, Lelouch manages to win Suzaku over by agreeing to stop the war. However, Schneizel (Schneizel el Britannia) interrupts and has his personal guard arrest Lelouch, making him believe Suzaku has betrayed him.

events.title: Guilford rescues Lelouch
events.summary: After a private chat with Schneizel, Lelouch is rescued by Guilford, who is under the influence of Lelouch's Geass.
events.source: Schneizel and Lelouch have a private chat, until Lelouch is rescued by Guilford (Gilbert G.P.

events.title: Lelouch shuts down Tokyo with the G Trains
events.summary: Using the G Trains Lelouch shuts down the Tokyo Settlement while his reinforcements emerge from the ocean.
events.source: Using the G Trains, Lelouch shuts down the Tokyo Settlement; at the same time, his reinforcements emerge from the ocean, ready to take advantage of the opportunity.

events.title: The Emperor goes to Kamine Island to prepare Ragnarök
events.summary: The Emperor, with Monica Krushevsky, goes to Kamine Island in Area 11 to prepare for Ragnarök.
events.source: Meanwhile, the Emperor (Charles zi Britannia), accompanied by Monica Krushevsky, goes to Kaminejima Island in Area 11 to prepare for Ragnarök.

events.title: Black Knights assault the Tokyo Settlement
events.summary: With the power disrupted, the Black Knights begin their assault on the Tokyo Settlement.
events.source: With the power disrupted, the Black Knights begin their assault on the Tokyo Settlement (Second Assault on Tokyo Settlement).

events.title: Lelouch calls Suzaku's F.L.E.I.J.A. bluff
events.summary: Suzaku threatens to use the F.L.E.I.J.A. bomb, but Lelouch, having lost trust in Suzaku, calls his bluff.
events.source: Suzaku threatens to use the F.L.E.I.J.A. bomb, but Lelouch, having completely lost his trust in Suzaku, calls his bluff.

events.title: Kallen receives the Guren SEITEN and cripples the Lancelot
events.summary: Sayoko frees Kallen and escorts her to the upgraded Guren SEITEN, which overwhelms Luciano and severely cripples the Lancelot.
events.source: Rolo attempts to locate Nunnally in the government complex, but he secretly intends to kill her, while Sayoko frees Kallen and escorts her to the upgraded Guren SEITEN Eight Elements.

events.title: Suzaku's Geass forces him to fire F.L.E.I.J.A.
events.summary: On the verge of death, Suzaku's Geass command activates and compels him to fire the F.L.E.I.J.A., which detonates over the government complex and obliterates a large section of the settlement.
events.source: On the verge of death, Suzaku's Geass command activates and compels him to fire the F.L.E.I.J.A. Unfortunately, the bomb detonates over the government complex, obliterating a massive section of the settlement.

events.title: Rolo tells Lelouch Nunnally was killed
events.summary: Lelouch breaks down when Rolo tells him Nunnally was killed in the explosion.
events.source: Lelouch breaks down when Rolo tells him Nunnally was killed in the explosion.

events.title: Ceasefire; Schneizel reveals what he knows of Lelouch's Geass
events.summary: A ceasefire is called so Schneizel can meet the Black Knights' leaders, and he reveals what he knows about Lelouch and his Geass, including a recording of Lelouch accepting blame for Euphemia.
events.source: A ceasefire is called so Schneizel can meet with the leaders of The Black Knights. Lelouch, who is too devastated to attend the meeting, insanely lashes out at Rolo about the locket, and angrily orders Rolo out of his sight. Schneizel reveals what he knows about Lelouch and his Geass, as well as the many people he has used it on; he uses a recording from Lelouch's meeting with Suzaku where Lelouch accepts the blame for using Geass on Euphemia.

events.title: Kallen stops Lelouch's suicidal despair
events.summary: Devastated, Lelouch turns suicidal until Kallen stops him and says it is not his fault.
events.source: During the Meeting, a devastated-depressed Lelouch turns suicidal to ends his sins, but Kallen who turns up, stops and snaps him out of it.

events.title: The Black Knights agree to betray Lelouch
events.summary: In exchange for Japan's independence, the Black Knights agree to betray Lelouch.
events.source: In exchange for Japan's independence, the Black Knights agree to betray Lelouch.

events.title: Rolo rescues Lelouch and dies
events.summary: Rolo, piloting the Shinkirō, rescues Lelouch against his orders, and the excessive use of Geass overtaxes his heart and he dies.
events.source: Lelouch doesn't mind whether or not he dies and prepares to accept death, until Rolo, piloting the Shinkirō, rescues Lelouch, despite the latter's orders, and escapes the combined forces of the Black Knights and the Britannians. However, despite Lelouch's protests, the excessive use of his Geass required to do so overtaxes his heart and he dies shortly after flying a then-sorry Lelouch to safety; but content in the knowledge that the time he spent with Lelouch was real and, while he may have been used as a tool by everyone around him, possibly even Lelouch, his final action was of his own free will.

events.title: Lelouch resolves to kill the Emperor
events.summary: Lelouch resolves not to waste the life Rolo gave him and declares he will kill the Emperor by his own hand.
events.source: Lelouch resolves to not waste the life given to him by Rolo, declaring he will kill the Emperor by his own hand.

events.title: Lelouch and Suzaku head to Kamine Island
events.summary: As the Emperor prepares to begin Ragnarök, Lelouch and Suzaku separately head to Kamine Island to face him.
events.source: As the Emperor prepares to begin Ragnarök, Lelouch and Suzaku head to Kamine Island separately to face him.

events.title: Suzaku strikes a deal with Schneizel
events.summary: Suzaku strikes a deal with Schneizel to become the Knight of One in exchange for assassinating the Emperor.
events.source: No longer restrained by his notions of wrong methods being meaningless, Suzaku strikes a deal with Schneizel to become the Knight of One, in exchange for assassinating the Emperor.

events.title: Lelouch takes over Britannian forces on the island
events.summary: Using his Geass to its full potential, Lelouch takes over much of the Britannian military forces on the island.
events.source: Using his Geass to its full potential, Lelouch takes over much of the Britannian military forces on the island.

events.title: Black Knights declare Zero dead
events.summary: The Black Knights' leaders decide to declare Zero dead, but Lelouch's actions cast doubt on their story.
events.source: Meanwhile, the leaders of the Black Knights decide to declare Zero dead, as the truth will be far more difficult to swallow, but Lelouch's actions quickly cast doubt on their story.

events.title: Marianne restores C.C.'s memories through Anya
events.summary: Anya's mind is taken over by Marianne, who restores C.C.'s memories and puts their plan into motion.
events.source: Anya's mind is taken over by Marianne and she restores C.C.'s memories, putting their plan into motion.

events.title: Lelouch seals the Thought Elevator entrance
events.summary: Bismarck holds Suzaku at bay while Lelouch walks unopposed through the Thought Elevator; knowing he cannot kill his father, he destroys the entrance to seal them both inside.
events.source: At Kamine Island, Suzaku is held at bay by Bismarck, while Lelouch marches into the Sword of Akasha, through the Thought Elevator, unopposed. Knowing he cannot kill his father, Lelouch destroys the entrance, planning to seal them both inside for eternity.

events.title: Lelouch learns the truth of his mother's death
events.summary: Within the Sword of Akasha Lelouch learns the truth of his mother's death from the Emperor and Marianne; Suzaku and C.C. follow him in.
events.source: Within the Sword of Akasha, Lelouch learns the truth of his mother's death from the Emperor (Charles zi Britannia) and Marianne herself, then Suzaku and C.C. appears in after Lelouch.

events.title: Lelouch defeats his father with humanity's collective will
events.summary: Evolving his Geass, Lelouch defeats his father with the help of humanity's collective unconscious, dissolving his parents from existence.
events.source: They reveal their intention and initiate Ragnarök, Lelouch realizing that the world the Emperor desires has no future. Evolving his Geass to its next level, Lelouch defeats his father with the help of the collective unconscious mind of humanity, the personification of the "gods" (Gods) the Emperor sought to defeat, dissolving his parents from existence.

events.title: Suzaku blocks Marianne and spares Lelouch
events.summary: Suzaku blocks Marianne, who tries to intervene, and, still angry at Lelouch for killing Euphemia, draws his sword but refuses to kill him.
events.source: Marianne tries to intervene, but Suzaku blocks her and says not even Euphemia would've wanted this. Afterwhich, Suzaku, still angry at Lelouch for killing Euphemia, draws his sword, but refuses to kill him.

events.title: Lelouch becomes Emperor of Britannia
events.summary: One month later, with Ragnarök prevented, Lelouch seizes the throne as the new Emperor with the aid of Suzaku and C.C. and uses Geass to make all dissenters acknowledge him.
events.source: One month later, with Ragnarök prevented, Lelouch seizes the throne as the new Emperor of Britannia with the aid of Suzaku and C.C., having finally reconciled with both of them, and uses his Geass to make all dissenters in the court acknowledge him as such.

events.title: Emperor Lelouch begins reforming Britannia
events.summary: Lelouch begins reforming Britannia, abolishing the aristocracy and the Area system.
events.source: Lelouch begins his reformation of Britannia, abolishing the aristocracy and Area system.

events.title: Knights of the Round rebel and are defeated by Suzaku
events.summary: The Knights of the Round try to remove Lelouch from power, but Suzaku, piloting the Lancelot Albion, easily defeats them.
events.source: The Knights of the Round (Knights of the Round) attempt to remove Lelouch from power, but Suzaku, piloting the Lancelot Albion, easily defeats them.

events.title: Kallen asks what she means to Lelouch
events.summary: Lelouch takes the long route to the meeting, giving Kallen the chance to ask what he intends to gain as Emperor and what she means to him; when he stays silent she kisses him.
events.source: Lelouch gets her to take the long route, giving them the chance to speak in private. Kallen recounts their history, then asks Lelouch what he intends to gain by becoming Emperor, as well as what she means to him. Lelouch remains silent, so she kisses him to show her feelings.

events.title: Lelouch takes the U.F.N. leaders hostage
events.summary: When the UFN demands a limit on Britannia's voting power, Lelouch has Suzaku take the U.F.N. leaders hostage and Britannia's military surround Japan.
events.source: But when the UFN demand he accept a limit to his voting power to prevent Britannia from attaining an automatic majority, Lelouch forces their hand by having Suzaku take the U.F.N. leaders hostage and Britannia's military surround Japan.

events.title: Schneizel destroys Pendragon with the Damocles
events.summary: In the commotion Schneizel obliterates the Britannian capital Pendragon from his flying fortress, the Damocles, and reveals Nunnally is alive; she declares herself Lelouch and Suzaku's enemy.
events.source: In the commotion, the Britannian capital (Pendragon) is obliterated by Schneizel aboard his new flying fortress, the Damocles. He reveals to Lelouch that Nunnally is alive, and she declares herself to be Lelouch and Suzaku's enemy.

events.title: Schneizel unveils the Damocles plan
events.summary: Schneizel unveils his plan to position the Damocles to strike any warring nation, enforcing peace through the threat of annihilation; Cornelia objects and is gunned down.
events.source: Schneizel unveils his plan to position the Damocles in such a way as to strike every warring nation in the world, thus enforcing peace through threat of annihilation. Cornelia objects, but is gunned down.

events.title: Lelouch regains focus after Suzaku and C.C.
events.summary: After declaring Nunnally his enemy, Lelouch struggles with fighting her until harsh words from Suzaku and C.C.'s comfort bring him to his senses.
events.source: Lelouch declares Nunnally his enemy during their conversation, but in private has trouble with the thought of fighting her. With some harsh words from Suzaku and C.C.'s comfort, Lelouch comes to his senses and focuses on his original task.

events.title: Nunnally decides to shoulder the sin of F.L.E.I.J.A.
events.summary: Frustrated that she cannot fight or protect anyone, Nunnally decides to shoulder the sin of launching F.L.E.I.J.A. herself.
events.source: Frustrated that she cannot fight or protect anyone, Nunnally decides to shoulder the sin of launching F.L.E.I.J.A. herself.

events.title: Battle above Mount Fuji
events.summary: Schneizel, backed by the Black Knights and remaining Knights of the Round, clashes with Lelouch above Mount Fuji, and Lelouch destroys much of the Black Knights by detonating the Sakuradite mines, but the Damocles remains unassailable.
events.source: Schneizel, backed by the Black Knights (The Order of the Black Knights) and the remaining Knights of the Round, clashes with Lelouch in the skies above Mount Fuji. Though Lelouch is able to destroy a fair portion of the Black Knights by detonating the Sakuradite mines in Mount Fuji, the Damocles remains unassailable and its payload of F.L.E.I.J.A. warheads still looms over him.

events.title: Lelouch escapes in the Shinkirō
events.summary: The Black Knights board the Avalon, while Lelouch escapes in the Shinkirō with C.C. holding Kallen at bay.
events.source: The Black Knights manage to board the Avalon, while Lelouch escapes in the Shinkirō with C.C. holding Kallen at bay long enough for him to escape.

events.title: Lelouch and Suzaku break into the Damocles
events.summary: Using Nina's F.L.E.I.J.A. Eliminator, Lelouch and Suzaku break into the Damocles.
events.source: Using Nina's F.L.E.I.J.A.

events.title: Lelouch outwits Schneizel and Geasses him
events.summary: Schneizel sets the Damocles to self-destruct believing Lelouch trapped, but Lelouch outsmarts him and uses Geass to force him into obedience.
events.source: Believing Lelouch to be trapped, Schneizel sets the Damocles' self-destruct sequence and attempts to leave. However, Lelouch manages to outsmart Schneizel and uses his Geass to force him into obedience.

events.title: Diethard shot by Schneizel
events.summary: Diethard shoots a Geassed officer and holds Lelouch at gunpoint before Schneizel shoots him; dying, he asks for Geass and Lelouch says he is not worthy.
events.source: Diethard flies into a rage, shooting a Geassed officer dead and holding Lelouch at gunpoint, calling him Zero and proclaiming that he shouldn't be alive and that his plan is finished, before Schneizel shoots him. In his dying moments, Diethard asks Lelouch to use his Geass on him, to which Lelouch responds that Diethard isn't worthy of it.

events.title: Gino destroys the barrier; Nunnally has regained her sight
events.summary: Gino takes out the Damocles barrier with his last attack, allowing Kallen into battle; Lelouch confronts Nunnally, who has regained her sight.
events.source: Suzaku and Gino battle outside the fortress, with Gino unable to hold out against him. Using his last attack, Gino takes out the Damocles barrier, allowing Kallen to take his place in battle. Meanwhile, Lelouch confronts Nunnally, who reveals she has regained her sight which he thought she lost.

events.title: Final battle for the Damocles
events.summary: Lelouch confronts Nunnally for the Damocles key while Suzaku and Kallen fight a final showdown; Kallen seemingly kills Suzaku.
events.source: The final battle for the Damocles rages on between 2 separate major fronts: Lelouch confronting Nunnally for the Damocles key and Suzaku and Kallen engaging in one final showdown.

events.title: Lelouch takes the key and declares control of the world
events.summary: Lelouch acquires the Damocles key from Nunnally with Geass and declares he controls the F.L.E.I.J.A. weapons and the world.
events.source: The final battle concludes with Kallen seemingly killing Suzaku, but at the same time, Lelouch managed to acquire the Damocles key from Nunnally using his Geass. Broadcasing to the entire world, Lelouch declares that now that he controls the FLEIJA weapons, he now stands in absolute control of the world.

events.title: Zero stabs Lelouch
events.summary: Two months later, a Zero swiftly passes Lelouch's bodyguards and stabs him with Lelouch's own sword.
events.source: Two months later, Lelouch leads a convoy to execute those who rebelled against him before being stopped what appears to be Zero. Swiftly going past Lelouch's bodyguards, Zero then stabs him using the sword Lelouch himself once carried.

events.title: The Zero Requiem is revealed
events.summary: The Zero is Suzaku, who faked his death; the series' final battles were Lelouch's plan, the Zero Requiem, focusing the world's hatred on Lelouch so Suzaku as Zero could execute him.
events.source: The Zero stabbing Lelouch is revealed to be Suzaku, who faked his own death, and as it turns out, the entirety of the series' final battles was all part of Lelouch's final plan: the Zero Requiem. With the world's hatred now solely focused on Lelouch, Suzaku, as Zero would then execute him, allowing humanity to finally enter a peaceful future while remaining as Zero to help it along.

events.title: Lelouch dies; the world is rebuilt
events.summary: Lelouch dies having destroyed and rebuilt the world, which improves significantly; C.C. muses that Lelouch overcame his loneliness.
events.source: With only a few select people knowing the truth, Lelouch dies, having succeeded in destroying and rebuilding the world. With Lelouch's death, the world improves significantly as the people act together for the sake of the future. The series ends with C.C. musing to herself how Geass condemns people to solitude, but in Lelouch's case, this was wrong, happily noting how he overcame his loneliness.
